data.body:
Phase 2 frozen test contract card:
- authoritative_contract: story ef70-e108-e6d4-4d7c and bug ACs require a durable shared revision-scoped code_review artifact, v2 payload, relates_to link, non-blocking vote, and actionable bounded failure diagnostics.
- trigger_preconditions: real initialized local tickets clone; real bare origin seeded with cited work; origin then made unreachable during the first post-vote artifact write; confirmed local artifact/ahead state and one successful Gerrit vote.
- production_path: `review_and_vote` -> real emitter -> real append/commit -> real git push -> dedup retry guard. Gerrit network and LLM are the only stateful fakes.
- test_tier: stateful contract/integration test with real temporary Git repositories. A function-level unit test is insufficient because the defect is local-vs-remote reachability plus retry state.
- observable_postcondition: first vote remains successful and singular; failure emits ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR stage=publish; after the same ordinary delivery is retried with origin restored, exactly one artifact, its v2 payload, and its relates_to link are visible from a fresh remote clone, without a second vote.
- ci_gate: pytest exact node; make test / CI unit suite.
- negative_control: a third delivery while already synchronized creates no vote, artifact, or remote commit.
- collateral_invariants: cited work remains present; local tracker clean; idempotent artifact count one.
- recovery: clean retry after transport restoration publishes the pending artifact.
- fault_injection: replace the real tracker origin URL with a nonexistent local bare-repo path at the actual git-push boundary, then restore it.
